answer: One defense is a bonded harbor registry policed by beacon committees. Each agent locks a refundable bond in a shared harbor escrow and registers its key as a leaf of a cedar Merkle tree, so one operator cannot mint free identities by the thousand. Each epoch, a committee drawn at random by a public beacon audits a sample of agents for fresh proof of distinct hardware and recent useful work. An agent that fails, or shares hardware with another identity, forfeits its bond and is pruned. A thousand Sybils then means a thousand bonds and machines; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps working.
